zh: 我真希望当初多学了一门外语。
old_en: I wish I had studied a foreign language more back then.
new_en: I wish I had studied more foreign languages back then.

zh: 我希望小时候学过钢琴。
old_en: I wish I had learned piano when I was a kid.
new_en: I wish I had learned piano when I was a kid.

zh: 我后悔当时没有拍一张照片。
old_en: I wish I hadn't missed taking a photo that day.
new_en: I regret not taking a photo that day.

zh: 我希望当初选了另一个专业。
old_en: I wish I had chosen a different major back then.
new_en: I wish I had chosen a different major back then.

zh: 我后悔当初没有好好学外语。
old_en: If only I had studied foreign languages more diligently back then.
new_en: I regret not studying foreign languages more seriously back then.

zh: 我后悔没有早点开始存钱。
old_en: I wish I had started saving money earlier.
new_en: I wish I had started saving money earlier.

zh: 真后悔当初没早点存钱。
old_en: If only I had started saving earlier.
new_en: I really wish I had saved money earlier.

zh: 要是当时多问一句就好了。
old_en: If only I had asked one more question back then.
new_en: I wish I had asked one more question back then.

zh: 我真希望当时多问了一句。
old_en: I wish I had asked one more question back then.
new_en: I wish I had asked one more question back then.

zh: 我小时候要是学过钢琴就好了。
old_en: If only I had learned piano when I was a kid.
new_en: If I had learned piano when I was a kid, that would have been great.

zh: 我后悔昨天没去参加聚会。
old_en: I wish I had gone to the party yesterday.
new_en: I regret not going to the party yesterday.

zh: 真后悔昨天没去，听说特别热闹。
old_en: I wish I had gone there yesterday; it was supposed to be really lively.
new_en: I wish I had gone to the party yesterday; I heard it was really lively.

zh: 我后悔没有早点出门。
old_en: If only I had left earlier.
new_en: I wish I had left earlier.

zh: 早知道会堵车，我就早点出门了。
old_en: If only I had known there would be traffic, I would have left earlier.
new_en: If I had known there would be traffic, I would have left earlier.

zh: 真希望能回到那一天。
old_en: If only I could go back to that day.
new_en: I wish I could go back to that day.

zh: 我希望自己能回到那一天。
old_en: I wish I could go back to that day.
new_en: I wish I could go back to that day.

zh: 我后悔没有接受那份工作。
old_en: If only I had accepted that job.
new_en: I wish I had accepted that job.

zh: 真后悔当时拒绝了那份工作。
old_en: If only I had accepted that job back then.
new_en: I regret turning down that job back then.

zh: 要是当时拍张照片就好了。
old_en: If only I had taken a photo then.
new_en: If only I had taken a photo back then.

zh: 真希望当初选专业的时候多想想。
old_en: I wish I had thought more about my major choice back then.
new_en: I wish I had thought more about my major choice back then.
